recipes.decision: Where are observed settlement failures concentrated?

sections.interpretation: Which markets warrant operational investigation given their settlement volumes?
caveats: Without denominators, failure counts are not failure rates.

recipes.action: Investigate the observed markets using settlement volumes and operational incident evidence.

recipes.decision: Which processes carry unresolved breaks and older items?

sections.interpretation: Which processes need a review of their outstanding reconciliations?

sections.fallback_reason: Age-bucket evidence is unavailable; show the registered age measure by process instead of inventing aging buckets.
sections.interpretation: Does the governed age measure identify processes needing case-level review?
caveats: A mean age does not reveal a full age distribution.

recipes.action: Review outstanding reconciliations and inspect case-level aging where authorized.
